author: Mark Atwood
text: DECISION 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive): C) Verifier struct + keep verify_chain as thin wrapper convenience. NOTE: this REVERSES the tentative position recorded in this bead's description (A by default). The tentative position was wrong-frame: 'wait for concrete consumer driving the question' is post-launch reasoning that AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5 framing recalibration rejected. Under prelaunch 'design for the eventual complete shape' the answer is C. RATIONALE: (1) workspace already adopted mozilla::pkix's three-callback trust-domain seam (SignatureVerifier + RevocationChecker + AiaFetcher); those callbacks naturally compose on a single Verifier struct alongside trust anchors. (2) non-negotiable #6 caching/batching/prevalidation patterns land naturally on a struct; with free-function shape, callers maintain external state. (3) verify_chain as top-level function is the incremental-growth shape; Verifier-as-prepared-state is the architectural-completeness shape. (4) backwards compat: verify_chain stays as thin wrapper over Verifier::new().verify_one(), so existing callers migrate at their own pace. NEW EPIC FILED: implementation work goes in a fresh top-level epic for the Verifier struct restructure. IMPACT: PKIX-fmtv.11 (verify_tls_server design) needs note that the wrapper composes Verifier internally; AiaFetcher trait shape unchanged (just lands on Verifier struct as a field rather than function arg).
